correctness.rationale: Algebraic identity checks independently reconstruct all matrix entries. The hub diagonal is strictly decreasing with one root; strict discriminant inequalities rule out leaf-diagonal and center-leaf failures. A strictly positive cutoff comparison excludes leaf–leaf failures until after the hub root. The sharp normalized bounds follow from normalized moment inequalities. The standalone exact-rational verifier replayed 346,283 finite entry/row assertion groups; the universal statements have analytic proofs.

value.rationale: A natural, arbitrarily heterogenous network family admits a dimension-independent exact nonnegative-step decision using a single cubic, despite the need to check quadratically many matrix entries naively.
